column1: # Legacy Symbol/Wingdings source-byte to Unicode semantic mapping.
# Columns: normalized font family, source byte (hex), Unicode scalar (hex).
# Symbol source: Unicode Adobe Symbol Encoding mapping, table 1.0 (2011-07-12).
# Wingdings source: Unicode/WG2 N4363 status table (2012-10-13), Wingdings IDs 1033-1254.
# Source bytes also represent Microsoft symbol-font PUA values U+F000 + byte.
# Targets in an upstream corporate-use area are omitted unless their glyph names
